question: What happens to my pension if I die before or after I retire?

nuggets.text: A teacher separated after 5 years may elect a deferred annuity, with survivor annuities as the section provides.
nuggets.quote: after completing 5 years of eligible service and before becoming eligible for retirement, become separated from the service, the teacher may elect to receive a deferred annuity

nuggets.text: If a police officer or firefighter dies in the performance of duty, a $50,000 lump sum is paid to a dependent survivor.
nuggets.quote: lump-sum payment of $50,000 shall be made to his survivor if the survivor received more than one half of his support from such member
